changelog: 1- made the mod more compatible with Iris/Oculus and Continuity.
2- now the block contains master block index, its to render that specific block equally like vanilla.
3- same index is used to pop and use that specific block, by holding the added new key.
4- added full jade support that show the original blocks tooltip, if they are targeted or active index if can't be targeted, with full information about the multiblock.
5- another key added to reverse the block order R.
6- added a new state for the multiblock, to make it phantom, with no collison, if right clicked with a phantom memberine, and a bone meal to reverse it back to normal.
7- improved performance when chunk updates are concurrent during snow weather and fire events.
8- fixed some bugs, like items losing nbt data when popped or added, like chests and container items, now it's safe to pop and add when a chest is contained.
9- added compat with my PagableChests stack to nearby functionality.
10- finally now you can put full blocks inside each other and be able to interact with them.
